companionWelcome: Hello! I'm your desktop pet! Click on me whenever you want tips.
companionMessages: Hello! I'm your desktop pet! Feel free to explore at your own pace.
Open the Minigames folder to practice your clicking accuracy and speed!
Did you know? Right-click anywhere on the desktop to create a New Folder.
Try opening Notepad to practice typing words on the keyboard!
Remember: double-click quickly to open folders and apps!
Click the Start button on the bottom-left to see all apps and options.
You're doing great with the mouse! Keep it up!
You can drag windows from their top bar to move them around the desktop.
If a window is too small, click the square button to maximize it!
I'll always be here in the corner whenever you need advice!
medalImprovementMessages: Awesome improvement! You beat your previous record!
New personal best! Your practice is really paying off!
Fantastic upgrade! You earned a higher medal on this level!
Incredible progress! You're mastering the mouse!
wrongLeftClick: That was a left click! Try using the right mouse button!
wrongRightClick: Wrong click! Try using the left mouse button.
almostOut: Almost out! Aim closer to the center!
inactivityMessages: Take your time! Whenever you're ready, give it a click!
Need a hand? Aim carefully at the target area!
Don't worry, take all the time you need!
holdKeepPressing: Keep pressing! Hold the button down a bit longer!
holdStayInside: Stay inside the circle while holding down!
holdHoverStagnant: Now press and HOLD down the left mouse button!
holdInactivityReminder: Move your cursor onto the circle, then press and hold the left mouse button!
holdMissedBackground: Missed the target! Move the cursor inside the circle and hold the left button down!
holdQuickTapMessages: That was just a quick tap! Press and keep your finger down on the left button!
Don't let go right away! Press and hold the left mouse button down!
Hold it down! Keep pressing the button until the circle fills up!
holdMidReleaseMessages: Good start! Keep holding the button down a bit longer!
You're getting the hang of it! Just keep your finger pressed down!
Don't let go yet! Hold the left mouse button until the bar finishes!
holdAlmostDoneMessages: So close! Just hold it down for a tiny bit longer!
Almost there! Keep holding until the bar is completely full!
Nearly done! Hold steady for just another second!
holdSlippedOutsideMessages: Oops, your cursor slipped outside! Keep the mouse steady inside the circle while holding!
Stay inside the target! Hold the button down and keep your hand steady!
Careful not to move outside the circle while holding the button down!
clickMissed: Missed! Aim carefully inside the target circle!
clickDelayReminder: Aim carefully and click inside the circle!
doubleClickHoverStagnant: Click the left mouse button twice quickly! Click-click!
doubleClickInactivityReminder: Move your mouse to the target and double-click (two quick left clicks)!
doubleClickLeftBeforeSecond: Keep the mouse steady inside the target while clicking twice!
doubleClickMissedBackground: Missed the target! Move the cursor inside the circle and double-click!
doubleClickSingleClickMessages: That was only one click! Click twice quickly: click-click!
Too slow between clicks! Press the left button twice fast without moving the mouse!
Almost! Remember to do two quick clicks in a row!
dragAlmost: Almost! Drag the item all the way into the target zone!
dragTapWithoutDrag: Don't let go right away! Press and HOLD the left button while moving the mouse to the drop zone!
dragDwellReminder: Press and hold the left mouse button on the piece to grab it!
dragInactivityReminder: Grab the piece by holding down the left mouse button, then drag it to the target zone!
dragMissedBackground: Click and hold directly on the draggable piece to pick it up!
dragMissedDropMessages: Almost there! Keep holding the left mouse button until the piece is inside the target zone!
You let go a bit too early! Drag the piece all the way into the highlighted box before releasing!
So close! Move the piece right onto the target zone and then release the mouse button!
hoverKeepSteady: Almost! Keep the cursor steady inside the target until the bar fills!
hoverNoClick: No need to click! Just hold the mouse cursor over the circle!
hoverDontClickOutside: Don't click outside! Move your mouse inside the circle and hold it steady!
hoverStartReminder: Move your mouse over the target circle and hold it steady!
moveKeepMoving: Keep moving the mouse to clean all the spots!
moveNoClick: Just move the mouse over the spots without clicking!
rightClickReminder: Click the right mouse button on the target circle!
rightClickAimInside: Aim inside the circle and click the right mouse button!
rightClickHoverStagnant: Now press the RIGHT mouse button on the target!
rightClickBackgroundLeftClick: That was a left click outside! Move inside the circle and press the RIGHT mouse button!
rightClickBackgroundRightClick: Good right-click! Now do that right inside the target circle!
